purpose: Review a finite insurer underwriting exposure, premium earning, claim frequency and severity, case reserve and IBNR development, reinsurance recovery and catastrophe lifecycle domain before source rows, values, factor values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.matching_path_scope: Campaign172 reports and the two append-only unified reports
repository_evidence.enterprise_insurance_boundary: Campaign172 observes a listed enterprise as policyholder transferring its operating risks. Campaign189 observes an insurer as risk carrier earning premium, paying claims and estimating ultimate losses; policyholder coverage or claim reimbursement cannot substitute for insurer reserve development.
repository_evidence.regulated_capital_boundary: Campaign181 observes capital and solvency requirements, buffers, breach and restoration. Regulatory headroom does not identify underwriting exposure, accident year, paid or incurred claims, IBNR, reserve runoff or reinsurance recovery.
repository_evidence.operating_incident_boundary: Campaign166 observes issuer operational incidents. A catastrophe or insured event is an exposure origin, not an insurer claim cohort, loss-development triangle or ultimate-loss estimate.
repository_evidence.pricing_kpi_boundary: Campaign168 and Campaign169 cover scale KPIs and commercial pricing. Premium growth or rate alone does not establish earned exposure, claim frequency, severity, reserve adequacy or adverse development.
repository_evidence.sector_boundary: Point-in-time insurer, insurance group and line-of-business scope must be frozen; non-insurers remain structurally not applicable and cannot be filled with zero.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A latest reserve balance, loss ratio or combined ratio cannot be projected backward without accident, report, underwriting and development periods, claims payments, case estimates, IBNR, assumption changes, reinsurance recoveries, corrections and first-public histories.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: underwritten_exposure_written_earned_premium_retention_and_rate_adequacy_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known underwriting-book state linking policies or insured units, written and earned exposure, gross and net premium, cancellations, renewals, retention, limits, deductibles and rate actions by line and cohort.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted point-in-time history freezes regulated entity, policy cohort, line, territory, written and earned basis, exposure unit, cancellation, renewal, retention, limit, deductible, rate change, correction and first-public timing across 2019-2023.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: claim_incidence_paid_incurred_frequency_severity_and_settlement_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known claim-cohort state covering reported and closed claims, paid and incurred loss, frequency, severity, litigation, settlement, salvage and subrogation by accident and development period.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete accident-year and development-period claims history with exposure denominator, report and settlement lag, reopened claims, gross and net basis, salvage, subrogation, litigation, corrections and complete failed or open-claim coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: case_reserve_ibnr_ultimate_loss_and_reserve_development_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known reserve-estimation state linking case reserves, incurred-but-not-reported losses, ultimate loss, discounting, risk adjustment, assumption changes and favorable or adverse prior-year development.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source preserves loss-development triangles, case and IBNR components, actuarial method and assumption version, discount and risk adjustment, accident and underwriting cohorts, runoff, strengthening or release, restatement and trading-session availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: ceded_reinsurance_retention_recoverable_counterparty_and_catastrophe_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known risk-sharing state covering treaty and facultative cession, attachment and limit, retention, reinstatement, recoverables, counterparty collectability, catastrophe aggregation and commutation.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete point-in-time history connects insurer claim cohorts to ceded terms, recoverable recognition, counterparty, collateral, dispute, impairment, commutation, catastrophe aggregation, reinstatement, correction and first-public timing.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: accounting_liability_solvency_enterprise_policy_kpi_premium_price_or_security_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing accounting liability, prudential solvency, enterprise insurance policy, operating KPI, premium price or security-price state relabeled as insurer underwriting or reserve quality.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Those states do not identify earned exposure, accident cohort, claim frequency and severity, case reserve, IBNR, ultimate loss, development or reinsurance recovery.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: underwriting_direction_ratio_threshold_line_region_catastrophe_cohort_window_or_subset_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A direction, transform or subset of premium, retention, loss or combined ratio, frequency, severity, reserve development, line, geography, catastrophe, accident year or event window.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing growth or contraction, high or low loss ratios, favorable development only, a line, region, catastrophe, cohort, lag or window before source admission would multiply hypotheses and introduce underwriting survivorship.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_underwriting_claims_reserve_and_reinsurance_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A joint insurer underwriting-quality score across exposure and premium, claims experience, reserve development and reinsurance recovery states.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted source families or choosing cross-line normalization, weights, interactions, filters, subsets or models would expand the search before insurer scope and every base source contract are complete.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact regulatory return, exchange filing, annual or interim insurance note, actuarial report, claims triangle or licensed structured source with immutable bytes and stable insurer, group, document, table, line, cohort and observation identifiers
underwriting, accident, report, payment, settlement, reserve-estimate, development, correction, first-public, supersession and trading-session availability timestamps
listed security, insurance group, regulated carrier, branch, subsidiary, pool, cedant, reinsurer, broker and counterparty mapping without current-state leakage
point-in-time insurer and line-of-business taxonomy with structural not-applicability for non-insurers
policy, exposure, written and earned premium, cancellation, renewal, retention, limit, deductible and rate-change semantics
reported, open, closed, reopened, paid, incurred, frequency, severity, salvage, subrogation and settlement semantics by accident and development period
case reserve, IBNR, ultimate loss, loss-adjustment expense, discount, risk adjustment, actuarial method and assumption-version semantics
gross, ceded and net presentation plus treaty, facultative, attachment, limit, reinstatement, recoverable, collateral, dispute, impairment and commutation semantics
catastrophe, aggregation, event definition, exposure concentration, geographic and peril mapping without selecting only recognized events
opening, new business, claim emergence, payment, settlement, reserve strengthening or release, assumption change, acquisition, disposal and closing reconciliation
currency, unit, consolidation, accident versus underwriting year, calendar versus development period, missing, undisclosed, not-applicable, true-zero and double-counting semantics

complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full eligible-insurer denominator, entity and security identifier history, delisting and merger coverage, identity, timing, line, cohort, reserve-development, reinsurance and source-acceptance tests using no factor, comparator, security-price or return values

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four underwriting, claims, reserve-development and reinsurance lifecycle states remain deferred at source admission; adjacent-domain relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.

next_action: Append all seven scientific decisions to the Campaign189 hash chain and publish a prevalue checkpoint before terminal reporting and validation.
